Subject: Novara pilot: observation framework & handoff plan

Hi Lena / Arjun —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a clear, operational approach to the pilot observation phase so we can move quickly to a signed scope and a runbook you can hand to your ops team. High-level proposal below — please flag anything I’ve misunderstood and confirm owners/timing so we can lock schedules.

Summary of objectives
- Primary success metric: 95% acceptable suggestion rate on top-3 responses for physician-facing workflows (measured by Novara QA sample).
- Secondary: average end-to-end latency <= 220ms (95th percentile) and no PII leakage incidents.

Proposed evaluation approach (hybrid)
1) Online shadow (recommended): 5 business days of live shadowing on a 10% sampling rate from your staging traffic (approx 2.5k requests/day). Live shadow gives realistic latency/throughput signals and surfacing of regressions.
2) Offline simulated bench: parallel offline run using a curated seed set (2k prompts) to validate edge cases and for reproducible scoring across changes.

Why hybrid: the offline bench will give us repeatable comparisons when we try quantized variants; the online shadow will reveal integration/backpressure and contextual failure modes.

Proposed success gates (must pass all to move to canary)
- Functional: top-3 suggestion accept rate >= 95% on QA set (sampled and scored by Novara QA).
- Safety/compliance: zero high-severity PII flags during shadow; any medium flags triaged within 24h.
- Performance: 95th-pct latency <= 220ms under expected staging load.

Ownership & runbook owners
- Redwood AE (Jordan): program lead, weekly checkpoints, HubSpot updates.
- Redwood SE (Connor): instrumentation, shadow routing config, model variant recommendations.
- Redwood CS (Marissa): evaluation coordination, rubric consolidation, acceptance sign-off.
- Novara QA (Lena/Arjun): primary graders for human-eval samples, final sign-off on acceptance.

Timeline (draft)
- Fri 11/20: Agree final rubric + handshake on sample sets (deliverable: evaluation_rubric_v1.csv).
- Mon 11/23: Redwood SE deploys shadow routing in staging + quick smoke.
- Tue 11/24–Mon 11/30: 5 business days of shadow + offline bench runs.
- Tue 12/1: Joint review, acceptance decision or iterate.

Attachments: pilot worksheet and initial rubric stub (novara_pilot_observation_framework.xlsx, evaluation_rubric_v1.csv). Also included an instrumentation checklist we will use for the shadow routing.

Ask for you today: can you confirm (1) Novara QA can grade the provided rubric on or before 11/20, (2) staging access for shadow routing will be available the morning of 11/23, and (3) who from your engineering team will be our staging contact for network/firewall coordination?

If that all looks good I’ll update the HubSpot deal and send a short SOW addendum capturing the shadow windows and instrumentation responsibilities.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
